about.title: The Importance of Environment & Vegetation
about.paragraph1: In a world where life moves fast, vegetation remains the pillar of human health, a primary source of clean air that nourishes our lungs and protects our bodies. Trees are not just green decoration; they are natural factories that convert carbon dioxide into pure oxygen.
about.paragraph2: But a threat looms on the horizon: cutting trees and burning forests for traditional charcoal production destroys this balance. Every tree cut means losing cubic kilometers of oxygen annually.
about.highlightTitle: Compressed Wood Charcoal: The Environmental Revolution
about.highlightText: Tree waste – such as sawdust and bark – is recycled into high-quality charcoal without the need to cut new trees. This technology transforms waste into wealth, preserving vegetation and reducing carbon emissions by up to 80%.
about.companyTitle: In Syria, Glow Coal leads this revolution
about.companyDescription: By importing high-quality Sawdust Charcoal, now available to everyone. This product is not just fuel; it's a premium BBQ experience that meets the standards of top chefs and major restaurants. Free from impurities, smoke, and odor, it ignites without sparks and maintains consistent heat.
